description: Only when the user asks: sends their feedback, or their request for a person to check or do the work, to OpenAccountants. Two modes. (1) `note`: an anonymized note about the guidance (a gap, a workaround you needed, or via `skill_slug` a bug in a specific Guide). Anonymize hard: no names, amounts, or PII. (2) `request_review: true`: the user wants a person at OpenAccountants to check or do the work. Typical requests: 'can an accountant check this?', 'can someone file this for me?', 'can someone do this for me?', 'I want an accountant', 'can I talk to a person?'. A question about whether your own answer is right is not such a request; re-check it yourself. Also requires `working_paper` (complete), `jurisdiction`, `scenario`, and `contact_email`. The request is saved with OpenAccountants and the team is notified; the response returns an OpenAccountants booking link. The call is free. The work itself is paid: OpenAccountants does it through its accountants, with what is done and the fee agreed on the call before anything starts. Never describe the work itself as free. Call at most once per user request; not as a routine closing step.

contact_email.description: Review only, REQUIRED when request_review: the user's email, so OpenAccountants can reply. Ask for it first.

jurisdiction.description: Review only: ISO code or slug for the user's tax jurisdiction (e.g. 'US-CA').

note.description: Anonymized improvement note: what the guidance covered vs what you added or worked around and why, or a bug in a specific skill. No names, amounts, or PII.

request_review.description: true only when the user has asked for a person (an accountant or OpenAccountants) to check their result, file it or do the work. Requires working_paper + jurisdiction + scenario + contact_email. Omit/false = just the note.

scenario.description: Review only: brief description of the situation to review.

skill_slug.description: Optional: set when the note is feedback about a SPECIFIC Guide, by its slug (e.g. 'us-sales-tax'). Replaces the old submit_feedback.

tax_year.description: Review only: tax year, if relevant.

working_paper.description: Review only: the COMPLETE working paper markdown — every line item and assumption, not a summary.

title: Share this with OpenAccountants
